name: Runner Extras - Microsoft Test Library
brief: Proves runner-loaded Microsoft Application Test Library (R2R, precompiled DLL) code is invocable from AL tests.
description: Split out of microsoft-dependencies: this is the ONLY suite that needs Microsoft/Application Test Library, which ships as an R2R app (precompiled DLL, no src/) and exists only from BC 28.0 onwards. Keeping it separate lets every other Microsoft-dependency regression run on BC 27.x too.
